title: Enumerate before aggregating or applying bulk changes
pattern: all every each entire most least highest lowest total count bulk songs song files records pages
tip: When completeness matters, collect all relevant pages and containers before computing an aggregate or applying writes. Track observed identifiers and avoid submitting from a partial first page.

title: Classify and verify the complete collection
pattern: organize arrange sort photos photographs files directory subdirectories folders vacation move classify date month
tip: Enumerate the complete source collection before writing, classify every observed item from retrieved metadata, and track each item through its write. Before submitting, re-list or otherwise verify that no source item remains unprocessed.

title: Discover exact identifiers before mutation
pattern: file path directory folder contact person account record update delete move compress pay message
tip: Use read or list results to obtain exact identifiers, paths, and ownership before a write. Do not invent values that the environment can reveal.

title: Perform destructive terminal actions last
pattern: delete remove terminate compress archive cleanup migrate backup export account directory
tip: Finish discovery and creation of required outputs before deleting sources or performing an irreversible terminal action.

title: Resolve real accounts and reconcile payments before requesting money
pattern: coworkers friends roommates dinner bill shares paid sent venmo payment request note contacts people
tip: Read the source note, resolve each named person to an exact observed account identifier using available contact/user search tools, enumerate existing payments, and request only the unpaid difference. Never invent an email address from a name.
